description.value: Lala Ji's Pizzeria is a family-run Indian-pizza fusion restaurant in downtown Penticton, owned and operated by a father-and-son chef team with decades of combined experience in Germany, India, and Canada. The kitchen specializes in authentic Indian-style pizzas alongside traditional Indian dishes, making it a genuinely distinctive stop on the Okanagan touring circuit. Dine-in, takeout, and delivery are all available, and the online ordering system supports scheduled pickup.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and provides rich evidence. The business explicitly offers takeout and delivery ('TAKEOUT & DELIVERY' headline, online ordering page) and lists vegetarian/vegan items and gluten-free/dairy-free options on the menu. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site; those are marked null. Address (625 Main Street, Penticton) and phone (1-778-622-2211) come from the website since OSM has no contact fields populated.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone populated; both were sourced from the website only, so contact_confirmed is null for those fields.
Website copyright footer reads '© 2023' suggesting it may not be actively maintained, though the online ordering system and content appear functional.
Phone number on website is formatted as a single string '17786222211'; interpreted as +1-778-622-2211 (BC area code).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active restaurant in downtown Penticton with a functioning website and online ordering — straightforward inclusion for a cycling tourism directory.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes dedicated vegetarian/vegan items (Veggie Garden pizza, Veggie Mediterranean pizza, Veggie Samosa marked 'Vegetarian Vegan'). Website front page banner explicitly states 'GLUTAN FREE & DAIRY FREE' as a menu feature

wow_evidence: family-run Indian-pizza fusion restaurant... father-and-son chef team with decades of combined experience
